description: GOBACK RETURNING/GIVING identifier — an IMPLEMENTOR EXTENSION, not an ISO phrase (kb/Work PB407). §2023:14.9.18.2's general format has exactly two alternatives inside its choice-indicator bracket, raising-phrase and status-phrase; there is no RETURNING or GIVING phrase, and §2023:14.9.18.4 GR2's RETURNING is the PROCEDURE DIVISION HEADER's item, not a phrase of the statement. The row is kept because the extension is accepted (the shipped 2002/goback_returning.cob golden runs it) and is gated at 2002 because GOBACK itself is a 2002 introduction — but it no longer cites a GOBACK clause as the authority for a phrase that clause does not contain.
citation: NOT ISO — an extension of §2023:14.9.18.2's general format
